prompt: Research one AI-native SMB financial operating-system investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: Accounting, tax, payroll, payments, and compliance platforms may use trusted agents and authoritative financial data to automate the SMB back office and deepen cross-sell, while general agents threaten interface pricing.
inputs.drivers: SMB digitisation; labour scarcity; tax and payroll complexity; payments and working capital; agents; open banking; regulation; SMB credit cycle.
inputs.value_chain: Accounting, tax, payroll, SMB fintech, payments, commerce, CRM, AI-agent platforms, and free or low-cost substitutes.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires proprietary financial graphs, compliance rules, distribution, and expert networks to improve ARPC, retention, attach rates, and service cost.
inputs.invalidation: Generic agents commoditise interfaces, data portability reduces switching, churn or credit losses rise, inference costs remain high, or adjacencies fail.
